title: K-Silverfox Solo #41 (한국 · 실버폭스만 · 식물 · 체형 super hourglass)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean silver fox goddess luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin elegant silver-era maturity, early 40s, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white loose waves cascading to her waist — full body living peony growing directly from her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, not a dress, every stem rooted directly into her living skin and every petal standing up in true three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. BLAZING CRIMSON peony blossoms in full three-dimensional bloom across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID EMERALD leaves and curling tendrils filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels entirely overgrown with the same living peony blooms and vines, extra long nails with tiny peony petals embedded at each tip.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
